knowledge.q: How many missions are there in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t published the number of missions or the number of chapters. All we know is that the story is split into chapters, and that Rob Nelson took about 80 hours to finish his playthrough, story and optional objectives included. The list will fill up at launch.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Missions” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: How do you unlock a mission in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: The requirements haven’t been published mission by mission. Rob Nelson warns that missions alone don’t pay enough to move the story forward: you’ll also have to make money on the side, by robbing stores or gang hideouts.

knowledge.q: Which missions pay the most in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: There’s no way to rank them for now. Rockstar hasn’t published any mission earnings or duration: the calculator’s activities are examples to replace with your numbers. As soon as a mission has published earnings and a duration, it will join “My activities”, which compares what everything pays per hour.
